title: Collapse of the polynomial hierarchy to level two
statement: Suppose every language in $\mathrm{NP}$ has polynomial-size Boolean circuit families with fan-in at most two that decide it. Then the polynomial hierarchy $\mathrm{PH}$ equals $\Sigma_2^P$.
hypotheses_covered: Every language in $\mathrm{NP}$ has a family of fan-in-two circuits whose sizes are bounded by a polynomial in the input length and whose accepted language is that language
